changeSet.comment: UI 收敛：资产台账并入数据搜索页表格视图（/catalog/search?view=table）。 /catalog/assets/ledger 旧深链由前端重定向，菜单项 soft-delete 以避免角色授权引用失效。
changeSet.sql: UPDATE portal_menu SET deleted = TRUE, last_modified_by = 'system', last_modified_date = now() WHERE deleted = FALSE AND ( name = 'sys.nav.portal.dataPortalDetail' OR metadata LIKE '%"externalLink":"/catalog/assets/ledger"%' OR metadata LIKE '%"title":"资产台账"%' );
